selection_policy: Frozen EXP-0012 ES operating point; no parameter search
primary_metric: Joint net-ATR-R and max-drawdown improvement by era
success_rule: Treatment improves both net R and max drawdown on full sample and at least 3 of 4 predefined eras
weakener: Benefit disappears at 0.5 tick per side or treatment materially worsens worst-day or worst-week net R
